exams.name: Board-administered HVAC licensing examination
exams.notes: Required for master, master restricted, limited, journeyman, and journeyman restricted licenses. Passing score is 70%. Board may use a testing service.
exams.quote: pass an examination administered by the Board

interval_years.quote: Unless the license is renewed for a 2-year term as provided in this section, a license expires on the first October 1 that comes: (1) after the effective date of the license; and (2) in an odd-numbered year.

available.quote: the Board may waive the examination requirements of this title for an individual who is licensed in another state to provide heating, ventilation, air–conditioning, or refrigeration services as a journeyman, journeyman restricted, master, master restricted, or limited heating, ventilation, air–conditioning, and refrigeration contractor.

requirements.value: Applicant must pay the application fee, hold an active equivalent license in good standing in the other state, meet MD qualifications including equivalent years of work experience, and the other state must offer reciprocal exam waiver to MD licensees.
requirements.quote: the applicant: (1) pays the appropriate application fee required by § 9A–207 of this title; and (2) provides adequate evidence that the applicant: (i) meets the qualifications otherwise required by this title; (ii) holds an active license in good standing in the other state; (iii) holds a license that is equivalent to the State license; and (iv) became licensed in the other state after meeting, in that state, requirements that are at least equivalent to the licensing requirements of this State

exists.quote: There is a State Board of Heating, Ventilation, Air-Conditioning, and Refrigeration Contractors in the Department.

regulatory_model.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual provides or assists in providing heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services in the State.

credential_type.quote: "License" means, unless the context requires otherwise, a license issued by the Board to provide or to assist in providing heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services.

is_mandatory.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual provides or assists in providing heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services in the State.

title_protection.quote: Unless licensed to provide heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services under this title, a person may not represent to the public by use of the titles "heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, and refrigeration license holder", "registered heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, and refrigeration contractor", by other title, or by description of services, methods, or procedures, or otherwise, that the person is licensed to provide or to assist in providing heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services.

scope_protection.quote: an individual may not provide, attempt to provide, or offer to provide heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services unless issued a master license by the Board.

bonding_required.quote: If a county, municipal corporation, special taxing district, or other political subdivision requires a master, master restricted, or limited heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, and refrigeration license holder...to execute a surety bond under local heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, and refrigeration requirements, the person may satisfy the bond requirement by submitting proof of the insurance required under this section.

insurance_required.quote: A holder of a master, master restricted, or limited heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, and refrigeration license may not contract to provide services on behalf of the licensee, or another person who provides heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services, unless the work of the licensee, including completed operations, is covered by: (1) general liability insurance in the amount of at least $300,000; and (2) property damage insurance in the amount of at least $100,000.

definition_quote.value: "Provide heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services" means to install, maintain, alter, remodel, or repair heating systems, cooling systems, refrigeration systems, ventilation systems, or hydronic systems.
